name: ST Product Review Generator
author: Kristyna Bennett

sections.description:
In today’s digital world, customers share their experiences everywhere — on Google, Instagram, WhatsApp, Facebook, and other trusted platforms — but not always on your website. As a result, your product pages may look empty even though your business has plenty of positive feedback elsewhere.

ST Product Review Generator bridges this gap by allowing you to manually copy and paste real customer reviews from any platform and instantly display them on the right WooCommerce products. No complex integrations, no API keys, and no coding required — just a simple, powerful way to ensure every product page reflects your customers’ satisfaction.

Built for all types of users — from small online stores to large eCommerce brands and digital agencies — this plugin makes review management faster, smarter, and completely under your control.

Why This Plugin Exists

Most customers share their feedback on platforms like Google My Business, Instagram, or WhatsApp rather than directly on your website. This often leaves your product pages empty, even when you have genuine, happy customers elsewhere.
Adding reviews manually one by one takes a lot of time. ST Product Review Generator solves that problem by letting you copy and paste multiple reviews (names and messages) at once and instantly assign them to your products.

How It Works

  1. Select Product Category – Choose which WooCommerce category to work with.
  2. Select Product – Pick one or more products for review generation.
  3. Add Reviewer Names – Enter one name per line (for example, John, Stacy, Alex).
  4. Add Review Content – Write or paste each review message, one per line.
  5. Select Number of Reviews – Choose how many you want to generate (for example, 5).
  6. Set Rating Range – Select any rating between 0 and 5 stars.
  7. Pick Review Date – Choose the review posting date.
  8. Click Generate – Instantly push all reviews to the selected product(s).

All reviews are created and stored natively in your WooCommerce database, just like organic product reviews.

Review Dashboard and Insights

The plugin also includes a built-in review management overview that helps you track your review activity.
It shows:
• Total Products – How many products exist in your store.
• Products with Reviews – How many products already have customer feedback.
• Products without Reviews – Identify products that still need attention.
• Total Reviews Generated – Track the number of reviews you’ve created using the plugin.

This makes it easy to monitor progress, maintain consistency, and plan where to add more reviews.

Why Use This Instead of Review Site Integrations

While third-party review integrations like Google or Trustpilot widgets show external reviews, they come with limitations:
– They don’t link reviews to specific products.
– They can’t merge reviews from multiple sources (Google, Instagram, WhatsApp, etc.).
– You can’t select, edit, or control visibility of reviews.
– Many require API keys, subscriptions, or a complex setup.

With ST Product Review Generator, you stay in control. Simply copy customer feedback from any source and publish it directly to the right product pages.

Free and Pro Version

The free version of ST Product Review Generator includes 5 credits, where 1 credit = 1 review generated.
You can instantly generate up to five product reviews to test and experience the plugin’s power.

If you need more, upgrade to the Pro version for just $19, which gives you 200 credits to generate even more reviews across your store.
This flexible credit system ensures you only pay for what you use — perfect for both small stores and large eCommerce brands.

👉 Upgrade to Pro

Ideal For

  • Businesses that want to bring real customer voices from other platforms onto their site.
  • Store owners who need to populate review sections efficiently.
  • Agencies and developers setting up demo stores or testing WooCommerce review layouts.

Transparent and Ethical

This plugin is designed for manually adding genuine customer feedback that your business already receives on other platforms. It does not import or auto-generate fake reviews.
Your goal stays authentic: to represent real customer experiences directly on your website, faster and smarter.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin import reviews automatically?

No. You manually copy and paste reviews (names and content) from other platforms to maintain control and accuracy.

Are fake or generated reviews allowed?

No. This plugin is intended for publishing genuine customer feedback that your business has already received elsewhere.

Can I use this plugin without WooCommerce?

No. This plugin is designed specifically for WooCommerce product pages.

How many reviews can I add with the free version?

The free version includes 5 credits, allowing you to generate up to five reviews. For more credits, upgrade to the Pro version.

What do I get in the Pro version?

The Pro version costs $19 and provides 200 credits to generate reviews in bulk, along with priority support and upcoming premium features.
